title: Tokenized gold drives 25% of RWA growth in 2025 with 177% surge
summary: Onchain gold products added billions in new value last year, outpacing physical bullion and most gold ETFs as trading activity increasingly shifted to blockchain rails.

title: Spain’s Bankinter joins $35M Bit2Me round amid growing bank crypto alliances
summary: Bankinter joins Tether and BBVA in the $35 million investment round after the Spanish crypto exchange received its MiCA license in 2025.

title: Perp DEXs will ‘eat’ expensive TradFi in 2026: Delphi Digital
summary: Perp DEXs handle only a fraction of the trading activity seen in TradFi investments, but their infrastructure is catching up to the slow and fragmented centralized trading venues.

title: Backpack exchange launches beta testing of prediction market platform
summary: Backpack exchange launched an invite-only beta for its Unified Prediction Portfolio, letting users hedge and trade across markets in a single crypto account.

title: Visa taps BVNK to power stablecoin payouts on Visa Direct
summary: Visa has chosen BVNK to power Visa Direct pilots using stablecoins, enabling pre-funded cross-border payouts to wallets in select markets.

title: Bitcoin cools near $96.5K as markets shrug off US tariff uncertainty
summary: Bitcoin held near yearly highs as traders weighed geopolitical risks and a potential US Supreme Court tariff ruling that markets appear to have already priced in.

title: Animoca buys Somo as NFT market rebounds early in 2026
summary: Animoca’s acquisition of Somo comes as NFT market data shows a short-term increase in prices and trading activity early in 2026.

title: Galaxy says Senate crypto bill risks expanding Treasury surveillance authority
summary: Galaxy says the draft crypto market structure bill would give the US Treasury new powers to freeze transactions and deploy Patriot Act–style measures.

title: France flags 90 unlicensed crypto companies ahead of MiCA cutoff: Report
summary: Of the 90 crypto businesses registered in France without a MiCA license, 40% are not seeking the license, while 30% remain unresponsive as regulators warn of July shutdowns.

title: UK rolls back digital ID for work checks as privacy fears drive backlash
summary: UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer scrapped plans to make digital ID mandatory for workers after a backlash over “Orwellian” surveillance fears.
